movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Security Gateway Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow an attacker to execute remote code or directly impact confidential data and critical systems.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-49706. CVE-2025-53770 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49704, and the updates for CVE-2025-53770 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49704.

movers24h.product: Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways contain a stack-based buffer overflow which can lead to unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup and Replication Deserialization Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Veeam Backup and Replication contains a deserialization vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services contains a deserialization vulnerability when handling page requests incorrectly. An authenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the Report Server service account.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure contain a command injection vulnerability in the web components of these products, which can allow an authenticated administrator to send crafted requests to execute code on affected appliances. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2023-46805, an authenticated bypass issue.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Qlik Sense HTTP Tunneling Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability due to the incomplete fix of CVE-2021-44228, where the Thread Context Lookup Pattern is vulnerable to remote code execution in certain non-default configurations.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server allows for server-side request forgery. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082 which allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: dotCMS Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: dotCMS ContentResource API contains an unrestricted upload of file with a dangerous type vulnerability that allows for directory traversal, in which the file is saved outside of the intended storage location. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in MailboxImportServlet. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-27925 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: QNAP NAS devices running Photo Station contain an improper access control vulnerability allowing remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Quest KACE System Management Appliance Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The '/common/download_agent_installer.php' script in the Quest KACE System Management Appliance is accessible by anonymous users and can be abused to perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SMBv1 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The SMBv1 server in multiple Microsoft Windows versions allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat JBoss Application Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The JBoss Application Server, shipped with Red Hat Enterprise Application Platform 5.2, allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted serialized data.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apache HTTP Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
movers24h.shortDescription: A crafted request uri-path can cause mod_proxy to forward the request to an origin server choosen by the remote user. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server 2.4.48 and earlier.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Validation Key Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server Validation Key fails to properly create unique keys at install time, allowing for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability due to the Windows Print Spooler service improperly performing privileged file operations. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to perform remote code execution with SYSTEM privileges. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of PrintNightmare.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft MSHTML Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft MSHTML contains a unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft MSCOMCTL.OCX Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft MSCOMCTL.OCX contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution, allowing an attacker to take complete control of an affected system under the context of the current user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an unspecified memory escape vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall Email Security Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall Email Security contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an attacker to create an administrative account by sending a crafted HTTP request to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20022 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: JetBrains TeamCity Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: JetBrains TeamCity contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow limited admin actions to be performed.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized and unauthenticated access. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2024-55550, which allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read arbitrary files on the server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: CyberPanel Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands as root.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Quantum Security Gateways Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Check Point Quantum Security Gateways contain an unspecified information disclosure vulnerability. The vulnerability potentially allows an attacker to access information on Gateways connected to the internet, with IPSec VPN, Remote Access VPN or Mobile Access enabled. This issue affects several product lines from Check Point, including CloudGuard Network, Quantum Scalable Chassis, Quantum Security Gateways, and Quantum Spark Appliances.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution via a specially crafted request.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains an out-of-bound write vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute code or commands via specifically crafted requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Photo Station Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Kaseya VSA SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ConnectWise ManagedITSync integration for Kaseya VSA is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote commands that allow full direct access to the Kaseya VSA database.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DNS-320 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The login_mgr.cgi script in D-Link DNS-320 is vulnerable to remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: DotNetNuke (DNN) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains a vulnerability that may allow for remote code execution via cookie deserialization.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA) Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA) contains an information disclosure vulnerability allowing an attacker to obtain the sessionId that can be used to execute further attacks against the system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block (SMBv1) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: RARLAB WinRAR Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting the Windows version of WinRAR. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code by crafting malicious archive files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Internet Shortcut Files Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Internet Shortcut Files contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a security feature bypass.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

movers7d.product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-Central Insecure Deserialization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: N-able N-Central contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that could lead to command execution.

movers7d.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that can be exploited by an attacker with existing administrative privileges to upload a malicious file. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow a remote attacker to execute underlying operating system commands within the context of the site user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could attempt to impersonate any other user of the Exchange server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Group Encrypted Transport VPN Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco IOS and IOS XE contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Group Encrypted Transport VPN (GET VPN) feature that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker who has administrative control of either a group member or a key server to execute malicious code or cause a device to crash.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: iCagenda Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin contains privilege escalation vulnerability that is exposed via the user-end cPanel plugin, which can be abused by any cPanel user account to execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This could allow a malicious actor with network access to vCenter Server to send specially crafted network packets, potentially leading to remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause an arbitrary memory write and memory corruption.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: TP-Link Multiple Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: TP-Link TL-WR940N V2/V4, TL-WR841N V8/V10, and TL-WR740N V1/V2 contain a command injection vulnerability via the component /userRpm/WlanNetworkRpm. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: ASUS RT-AX55 Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: ASUS RT-AX55 devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. As represented by CVE-2023-41346.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiFone, FortiVoice, FortiNDR and FortiMail contain a stack-based overflow vulnerability that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: GeoVision Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Multiple GeoVision devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to inject and execute arbitrary system commands. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Advantive VeraCore SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Advantive VeraCore contains a SQL injection vulnerability in timeoutWarning.asp that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the PmSess1 parameter.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware ESXi Arbitrary Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware ESXi contains an arbitrary write vulnerability. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with privileges within the VMX process to trigger an arbitrary kernel write leading to an escape of the sandbox.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Roundcube Webmail Persistent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Roundcube Webmail contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Integer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS. iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an integer overflow vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the notification function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the ID processing function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiVoice Connect Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Director component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute code within the context of the application.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiVoice Connect Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Mitel Edge Gateway component of MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute commands within the context of the system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read/write data from/to IO ports. This could be leveraged in a number of ways to ultimately run code with elevated privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The overlayfs stacking file system in Linux kernel does not properly validate the application of file capabilities against user namespaces, which could lead to privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The get_user and put_user API functions of the Linux kernel fail to validate the target address when being used on ARM v6k/v7 platforms. This allows an application to read and write kernel memory which could lead to privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Unspecified Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an unespecified vulnerability described as a design flaw which could allow a specially crafted file to be printed silently an arbitrary number of times.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when components of Windows, .NET Framework, Office, Lync, and Silverlight fail to properly handle TrueType fonts.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: QNAP NAS File Station Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Update Notification Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Update Notification Manager contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability that can occur when manipulating JavaScript objects due to issues in Array.pop, allowing for an exploitable crash.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) improperly handles hard links.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WhatsApp VOIP Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A buffer overflow vulnerability in WhatsApp VOIP stack allowed remote code execution via specially crafted series of RTCP packets sent to a target phone number.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Checkbox Survey Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in CheckboxWeb.dll of Checkbox Survey allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ruby on Rails Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in actionpack/lib/abstract_controller/base.rb in the implicit-render implementation in Ruby on Rails allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a crafted request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

newest.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

newest.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.
